Method of Attack: Abuse of iTunes Wi-Fi sync feature to take control of iPhone devices without owner knowledge
Recording smartphone screen by taking repeated screenshots via iTunes API
Triggering remote backups and retrieving victim data
Enabling iTunes Wi-Fi sync feature via malware on Mac to infect paired iPhones on same WiFi or VPN network
Attack Vector: Pairing iPhone with malicious Mac device via iTunes Wi-Fi sync
VPN network access if Mac and iPhone are on same VPN
